note: Pruebas del encaminador por tipo de caso y del cierre sin pregunta. Etapas, etiquetas y textos son inventados.

una.label: Una llamada
una.input: ONE-PASS. Feed the heron before noon and say nothing about the weir.

parts.text: PART-FIXED-A. Wind the clock on the landing every evening before the ferry leaves.
PART-W1. Stack the oars by length against the north wall of the shed.
PART-W2. Chalk the hull number on the slip before the boat is hauled out.
PART-W3. Oil the winch on the quay before the first frost of the year.
PART-Q. End with one question about the harbour.
PART-FIXED-B. Latch the door of the net shed whenever the wind turns east.

routing.system: ROUTER-TEST. Label the last message with RED, BLUE, HUSH or ALL.
